Simulate a 2D compressible supersonic jet at inlet Mach 2.0 discharging into a quiescent ambient domain using OpenFOAM.
The solver application is rhoCentralFoam.
The domain is a rectangle of length 0.2 m in x and height 0.1 m in y, extruded one cell (approximately 1 mm) in z.
The nozzle exit height is H = 0.01 m (10 mm), centered vertically on the left boundary (from y = 0.045 m to y = 0.055 m).
The mesh is structured, approximately 400 cells in x and 200 cells in y, with 1 cell in z.
The patch frontAndBack is set to type empty.
Air is treated as a perfect gas with molecular weight 28.9664e-3 kg/mol.
In constant/thermophysicalProperties use hePsiThermo, equationOfState perfectGas, gas species, and transport model sutherland.
Thermodynamic variables in the fields file are T, e or h, and p (psi-based).
Inlet boundary (the slot region on the left wall): type fixedValue, U = (686 0 0) m/s, p = 101325 Pa, T = 300 K.
Left-wall regions above and below the slot: type noSlip for U, zeroGradient for p and T (solid walls).
Right boundary (far-field/outlet): type waveTransmissive for p and T, zeroGradient for U.
Top and bottom boundaries (far-field): type waveTransmissive for p and T, zeroGradient for U.
Initialise the interior field to ambient quiescent conditions: U = (0 0 0) m/s, p = 101325 Pa, T = 300 K.
In system/controlDict set application rhoCentralFoam, startTime 0, runToTime approximately 0.002 s, writeInterval as needed for convergence monitoring.
In system/fvSchemes use a Godunov or Lax-Friedrichs type flux for divSchemes appropriate to rhoCentralFoam, Euler or backward time scheme, and bounded gradient-limited snGradSchemes.
In system/fvSolution allow the solver to control the time step via a maximum Courant number of 0.5 with adjustTimeStep yes.
Generate the blockMeshDict with the described domain, slot opening on the left patch, and one cell in z with the z-direction patch set to empty.
